unit.title: Multiplication and Division (1)
unit.blurb: Multiplying whole numbers up to 4 digits by 2-digit numbers, dividing by 1- and 2-digit numbers, remainders, and tests of divisibility.
unit.subject: maths

O1.t: Estimate and multiply whole numbers up to 10 000 by 1-digit or 2-digit numbers.

O2.t: Estimate and divide whole numbers up to 1000 by 1-digit or 2-digit numbers, and interpret remainders.

O3.t: Use tests of divisibility by 3, 6 and 9 (and 2, 4, 5, 10, 100).

p: To work out 346 × 27, multiply by 7 and by 20, then add: 346 × 7 = 2422 and 346 × 20 = 6920, so 346 × 27 = **9342**.
When you multiply by the tens digit, remember it is tens: 346 × 2**0**.

p: A **remainder** is what is left over. In a story, decide whether to **round up** (buses needed) or **round down** (full boxes).
70 children, 30 per bus: 70 ÷ 30 = 2 r10, so you need 3 buses, not 2.

p: A number is divisible by **3** if its **digit sum** is divisible by 3. It is divisible by **9** if its digit sum is divisible by 9.
It is divisible by **6** if it is even and divisible by 3. Divisible by **4** if the last two digits make a multiple of 4.
14 is even but not divisible by 6, because 1 + 4 = 5 is not divisible by 3.
